runs.text: Source-grounded equity value: Moog market cap USD6483.777030m as of2025-09-27, from two separately priced outstanding share classes.; Avoids applying one class's price to the whole capital or using annual EPS shares for a dated equity value.; A usable dated equity component is available for the defined bridge; it does not establish borrower debt service or recoveries.; Analyst Interpretation; historical, Stale at2026-11-04.

EV construction remains qualified: Known-components principal/finance-lease/cash proxy USD7501.839030m; net-carrying alternative USD7501.525030m; fair-debt alternative USD7488.409030m. Complete EV remains Insufficient Information.; Debt conventions alter the subtotal, while unestablished preferred/minority/investment and economic adjustments prevent a complete claim.; Keep the exact convention and gaps attached to any use. None is a source-backed TDG recovery floor or proof of creditor coverage.; Analyst Interpretation; calculated components, Provisional EV context.

Revenue indication is margin dependent: Moog proxy/revenue1.943167x applied unrounded to TDG FY2025 sales USD8831.000000m gives USD17160.112063m.; A sales-based transfer imports the peer's earnings economics; TDG's earnings relative to sales differ materially.; Use as sensitivity to the chosen operating analogue. It does not support a standalone value cushion, adverse credit conclusion or trading preference.; Analyst Interpretation; Provisional, N=1, differing business mix.

EBITDA indication is definition dependent: Moog proxy/constructed EBITDA15.358427x applied unrounded to TDG ordinary EBITDA USD4568.000000m gives USD70157.294567m. TDG As Defined USD4760.000000m was not substituted.; Expense-labelled versus net interest and other unnormalized earnings differences affect comparability. The larger ordinary-earnings base relative to sales drives a much higher conditional indication.; Do not select it because it is larger, average it with the sales result or treat the separation as a peer valuation range. First resolve earnings/perimeter compatibility.; Analyst Interpretation; Provisional, not normalized or a recovery estimate.

Missing methods and stale admission remain missing: Both transaction methods, complete EV, sector median/average/range and current native admission are unavailable or excluded.; Unsupported transaction EV or a one-peer distribution cannot provide independent triangulation. A historical case cannot become a current quote by changing the run label.; Preserve the gaps in delivery and future CP-OS completion tracking. Historical function exercised; current/full valuation remains unproven.; Insufficient Information; targeted source/normalization work required.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
**Ready with Limitations.** Construct a real dated equity value and known-components
enterprise-value proxy from Moog's FY2025 filing, then demonstrate conditional
individual-peer valuation communication to TDG's FY2025 credit synthesis. The
current host model opened the frozen instructions, input handoff, original SEC
filing passages and calculation transcript. Execution2026-11-04 has preceding
context; it is not isolated provider execution, independent assurance or native
acceptance. The positive calculation does not establish complete EV, normalized
comparability or a current sector valuation.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
`inputs.json` pins the exact selected archived CP-1C method/reference and later
Decimal helpers, plus the frozen request, input handoff, source capture and
pre-production independent Fraction expectations. `calculations.json` retains
the unchanged production context's unrounded results and21 oracle comparisons.
The wider selected method's valuation duties govern this increment; the narrower
native user-context route is not substituted for source-grounded analysis.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
The retained capture hash identifies web-tool passages, not original HTML/PDF
bytes. Direct downloads failed; full-document extraction/equivalence is unproven.
Financial quantities come from the located primary filing body rather than a
search snippet. Candidate selection remains **Web-Scraped — Unverified**; source
corroboration of numbers does not establish an approved peer universe.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
The EV identity is equity market value + total debt + minority interests +
preferred equity − cash/equivalents − eligible liquid available short-term
investments. The calculated subtotal here is equity + gross borrowings + finance
leases − reported cash. Unestablished additional interests/investments remain
missing; they are not mapped to zero to turn this subtotal into complete EV.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
This is a calculated individual point. It is not a current quote, a sector
multiple, the native controller's selected basis or a full-value valuation.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
The approximately USD17.160bn and USD70.157bn indications are different methods,
not endpoints of a valuation range. The large separation follows the different
earnings-to-sales bases: applying the same peer EV per sales dollar implicitly
imports Moog's much lower reported-line earnings margin. Applying the peer's
earnings multiple instead values TDG's larger ordinary EBITDA relative to its
sales. That sensitivity demonstrates why a business-mix and earnings-definition
judgment is necessary; it does not prove either indication fair. Do not average
the results, call the difference an outlier premium, or substitute adjusted
EBITDA4760.000000 USDm to manufacture a higher indication.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
The unchanged existing CP-1C Decimal context computes these operations. The
independent Fraction oracle, frozen before this execution and output, agrees
across21 monetary/ratio checks. This verifies arithmetic against source literals;
the same host saw the oracle, so it is not blind review or independent-model
assurance. Source numbers are rounded to their reported precision, and unknown
economic adjustments could matter more than displayed computational decimals.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
Complete economic EV remains Insufficient Information: preferred/minority market
values, eligible investment deduction, cash availability and full debt-like
adjustments are not established by the retained passages. No missing adjustment
was converted to a factual zero. Nor are there supported transaction comps,
normalized interest-income/earnings adjustments, an approved broad peer universe,
current prices or a valid sector statistical distribution. The native current-date
admission check excludes this stale record; it is not overridden or promoted.
Full raw-file retention, full filing inspection and native CP-OS integration
remain open. A populated historical case is not complete current underwriting.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
CP-2 must read this handoff and retain the two conditional indications as
definition-sensitive context only, alongside the complete-EV and transaction
gaps. Explain the sales/margin dependence and the unresolved interest basis;
do not infer debt coverage, recovery, equity upside or a security preference.
Then the separate delivery process must copy these findings, tables, arithmetic
and limitations into the existing report design, preserving each handoff's source
lines and hashes. No further analytical run is needed merely for publication.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
Consume the checked CP-1C FY2025 handoff without repeating its analysis. This
current host-model response read the pinned producer, input increment, retained
source passages and verification. It has preceding context and is not an
independent/native execution. The result is an incremental valuation-context
assessment, not a complete TDG credit view, rating or security recommendation.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - CP-1-valuation-inputs.md: actual located FY2025 source operands and gaps.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
- calculations.json and verification.json: arithmetic/copy/schema checks and
  the targeted retention repair for the original note4 receivables passage.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
- CP-2-request.md: frozen scope; CP-2's evidence → mechanism → credit consequence
  discipline is retained without imposing the native runtime's transport rules.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
The two conditional amounts are alternative analytical mappings of the same
historical peer subtotal. They are not independent corroboration of fair value.
Their separation changes the weight CP-2 can give valuation support: without
resolving the operating/earnings basis, valuation contributes a qualified
sensitivity rather than a stronger credit conclusion. Missing evidence does
not itself establish weakness or default risk.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
No new valuation calculation or ranking. CP-2 copies the checked producer's
figures and defined alternatives. The unrounded multiple/application record is
retained in calculations.json; the displayed multiple is not re-multiplied.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
No complete economic EV, current market evidence, qualifying transaction EV and
contemporaneous denominator, normalized interest-income/earnings bridge, approved
broad comparable set or full FY2025 issuer underwriting. Located web captures
are retained; full original-document byte equivalence/coverage is unproven.
Same-host execution does not provide independent assurance. These gaps limit
this intake and remain attached to the handoff rather than being replaced by
zeros, confidence scores, recovery estimates or a fabricated accepted head.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value:
The separate delivery process should publish CP-1C's actual tables and material
narrative plus this qualified consumption in the existing HTML report design.
Carry the complete-EV gap, the two Provisional methods, staleness, N=1 and exact
definition/date/unit distinctions into the visible report, not merely hidden
metadata. Preserve source-line/hash provenance. CP-OS integration and additional
transaction/current/normalized proof remain open; no workbook is required.
